# Bay Area Shine Cleaners

> Bay Area Shine is a home cleaning service across the Bay Area. Build your price online, pick a 3-hour window and book, and see your price up front.

Prices as of Oct 2026. Extras and repeat discounts apply on top.

## Services
- Standard home cleaning: kitchen, bathrooms, bedrooms and floors, done right every visit. One time, weekly, every 2 weeks or monthly.
- Deep cleaning: everything in a Standard clean, plus baseboards and buildup; inside windows, door frames, cabinet fronts and tile and grout are all part of it.
- Move-in and move-out cleaning: an empty home, ready for keys. Everything in a Deep clean, plus the inside of the oven, fridge and cabinets. One time only.
- Airbnb turnovers: one reliable cleaner for every turnover.
- Home organizing: closets, pantries and garages.
- Office cleaning: a fresh, clean workspace on the schedule that suits your team. Quote on request.

## Prices (as of Oct 2026)
| Home size | Standard | Deep | Move-in/out | Bathrooms included |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio / 1 bed | $150 | $230 | $280 | 1 |
| 2 bed | $185 | $315 | $380 | 2 |
| 3 bed | $235 | $405 | $480 | 2 |
| 4 bed | $280 | $490 | $580 | 3 |
| 5 bed | $340 | $595 | $705 | 3 |
| 6+ bed | $400 | $700 | $830 | 4 |

- Extra bathrooms (beyond those included): $20 each on Standard, $35 on Deep, $40 on Move-in/out. Repeat discounts apply to them too.
- Repeat discounts on Standard and Deep cleans: Weekly visits save 10%, every 2 weeks 7%, and monthly 5%.
- Extras: inside oven $35, inside fridge $35, inside cabinets $40, baseboards $30, windows from $40, laundry $25 a load. Deep includes baseboards and windows; move-in/move-out includes oven, fridge, cabinets, baseboards and windows.
- Organizing: $55 an hour, 3-hour minimum.
- $40 deposit holds your spot and comes off your cleaning total. It is non-refundable. The rest is due once the clean is done.
- Refer a friend: $25 off your next clean for every new client you send.

## How to book
Go to https://www.bayareashinecleaners.com/, build your price, and pick a 3-hour window (8–11 AM, 11 AM–2 PM, 2–5 PM), any day. We text to confirm. Rescheduling is free with 48 hours' notice. If we miss a spot, tell us within 24 hours and we come back to fix it, free. We bring all the cleaning supplies and equipment.
Questions and quotes: hello@bayareashinecleaners.com

## Service area
64 cities across the Bay Area, from East Contra Costa down to Fremont, and across to San Francisco and Marin. The full list is at https://www.bayareashinecleaners.com/#area
